p1.name: Flood Impact & WSS Damage
p1.method: Where DDA exists: 40% affected-population impact + 60% WSS impact. WSS impact uses assessed WSS beneficiary magnitude/share plus physical damage. Where DDA is absent, P1 uses affected-population impact only.

p2.name: Current Water Service & Safety
p2.method: Direct P2 = 50% current service + 50% water safety/public-health. Final P2 = 2.5 + coverage proxy × max(0, Direct P2 − 2.5). Coverage proxy = assessed DDA WSS beneficiary population / affected population, capped at 100%. No DDA => P2 2.5 provisional.

cautions: DDA WSS beneficiary populations are non-deduplicated service populations and may overlap.
The P2 coverage ratio is an evidence-coverage proxy, not a unique percentage of affected people assessed.
Coverage ratios are capped at 100% for scoring.
Physical damage is used in P1; service functionality is used in P2 to avoid double counting.
